text_ja: 第五条第二項第四号、第六条第二項第三号並びに第七条第二項第三号及び第五号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第五条第二項第四号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等の普通株式の額は、少数出資調整対象額(少数出資金融機関等(最終指定親会社等がその総株主等の議決権の百分の十を超える議決権を保有していない他の金融機関等をいう。以下この項及び第十一項において同じ。)の対象資本等調達手段を最終指定親会社等が保有している場合(連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて当該最終指定親会社等が実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含み、前項各号の場合を除く。)における当該対象資本等調達手段の額(その他外部TLAC関連調達手段にあっては、その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額(当該額を算出する場合においては、第十一項の規定にかかわらず、最終指定親会社等が少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段に係る一定のショート・ポジションを保有するときであっても、これらのその他外部TLAC関連調達手段と対応するショート・ポジションを相殺することはできないものとする。)から少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額(第五条第一項各号に掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第一号から第三号までに掲げる額の合計額を控除した額に五パーセントを乗じて得た額をいう。)を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合には、零とし、TLAC規制対象最終指定親会社にあっては、当該最終指定親会社等が保有しているその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額からマーケット・メイク目的保有TLACの額の合計額を控除した額とする。第四号において「基準超過その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額」という。)とする。)の合計額(以下この項において「少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額」という。)から少数出資に係る十パーセント基準額(同条第一項各号に掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第一号から第三号までに掲げる額の合計額を控除した額に十パーセントを乗じて得た額をいう。)を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合には、零とする。)をいう。以下この項において同じ。)に少数出資に係る普通株式保有割合(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうち普通株式に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額とする。二第六条第二項第三号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るその他Tier1資本保有割合(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額とする。三第七条第二項第三号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るTier2資本保有割合(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額とする。四第七条第二項第五号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るその他外部TLAC保有割合(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうち基準超過その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額とする。
text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iii), and Article 7, paragraph (2), items (iii) and (v) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of common shares of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the 10% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning the amount obtained by multiplying by 10% the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), items (i) through (iii) from the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of Article 5, paragraph (1)) from the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments (hereinafter referred to as the "total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments" in this paragraph) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph) — being the total of the amounts of target capital, etc. instruments held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. in minority-invested financial institutions, etc. (meaning other financial institutions, etc. in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. does not hold more than 10% of the total voting rights of all shareholders, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph and paragraph (11)) (including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc., but excluding cases falling under each item of the preceding paragraph), where the amount for other external TLAC-related instruments is the total amount of such instruments (provided that, in calculating such amount, notwithstanding paragraph (11), corresponding short positions may not be offset even if the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. holds certain short positions relating to such instruments) minus the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning 5% of the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), items (i) through (iii) from the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of Article 5, paragraph (1)) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero, and for a TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Company, it shall be the total amount of other external TLAC-related instruments held by such Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. minus the total amount of market-making TLAC; hereinafter referred to as the "above-threshold other external TLAC-related instruments amount" in item (iv)) — by the common share holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to common shares by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments). (ii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the Additional Tier 1 Capital holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments). (iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the Tier 2 Capital holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments). (iv) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the other external TLAC holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the above-threshold other external TLAC-related instruments amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments).

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iii), and Article 7, paragraph (2), items (iii) and (v) shall be calculated as follows.

(i) The amount of common shares of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the 10% threshold amount relating to minority investments from the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments (hereinafter referred to as the "total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments" in this paragraph); where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph) by the common share holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount equivalent to common shares of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments), where the minority investment adjustment amount is derived from the total of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. (meaning other financial institutions, etc. in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. does not hold more than 10% of voting rights; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph and paragraph (11)) held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (excluding cases under each item of the preceding paragraph), calculated by deducting the 5% threshold amount (meaning 5% multiplied by CET1 basic items net of items (i)-(iii) of Article 5, paragraph (2)) from the total of other external TLAC-related instruments (with no short-position netting permitted notwithstanding paragraph (11), where such amount is zero if negative, and for a TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Company is the total other external TLAC-related instruments held minus market-making TLAC; referred to as the "above-threshold other external TLAC-related instruments amount" in item (iv)), then deducting the 10% threshold amount (meaning 10% multiplied by CET1 basic items net of items (i)-(iii) of Article 5, paragraph (2)) from that total.

(ii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the Additional Tier 1 Capital holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments).

(iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the Tier 2 Capital holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments).

(iv) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the other external TLAC holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the above-threshold other external TLAC-related instruments amount among the target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments).
